faq_heading: Questions Dubai brokers ask about AI calling agents

faqs.q: How much does an AI calling agent for real estate cost?
faqs.a: Cost depends on call volume, the number of projects and sources, the languages and the systems it connects to. Clara AI sets the scope after a diagnosis and then shares a clear proposal.

faqs.q: How long does it take to go live?
faqs.a: Go-live depends on the call flows, the number of connections to your CRM and phone system, and how quickly your team approves the handover rules. Clara AI confirms a timeline after diagnosis, based on your actual material.

faqs.q: Will it connect to our CRM and portal leads?
faqs.a: Typically it reads new leads from your portal and form feeds and writes call outcomes back to your CRM. The exact connections are confirmed during diagnosis.

faqs.q: Will buyers know they are talking to an AI?
faqs.a: Yes. The agent says at the start that it is an automated assistant, and buyers can ask for a broker at any time.

faqs.q: Can it call people who did not enquire?
faqs.a: We design it for people who have enquired and given their number. Rules on outbound calling and consent apply, so we advise against cold calling and recommend checking with your legal adviser.
